build_insuranceqa_dataset: build the InsuranceQA dataset by downloading and converting V1 and V2 data files to ParlAI format
read_gz_compressed_file: read lines from a gzip compressed file and decode them to UTF-8 strings
read_vocab_file: read a tab-separated vocabulary file mapping word IDs to words into a dictionary
read_label2answer_mapping: read a label-to-answer file and map answer IDs to sentences using the vocabulary
create_fb_format_v1: create Facebook format text files from InsuranceQA V1 train, valid, and test data splits
